title: Moriti o o kafa Morago ga Setulo sa Bogosi
intro: O eme mo teng ga dikgotlatshekelo tsa bogosi jo bo nonofileng jwa bogologolo, koo mmusi yo o maatla a ipoleletseng gore ke modimo mo bathong botlhe. Fa thoko ga mmusi yono go eme motlhanka yo o ineetseng, yo o neetsweng dikeletso tse dikgolo thata tsa bogosi. Mmogo, ba loga leano le go loga maano, ba gana go tsaya tsia ditlhagiso tsa morongwa yo o rometsweng go tla go ba kaela. A o ka ribolola gore motlhanka yono yo o ikanyegang e ne e le mang?
clues: Ke ne ke nna mo bogosing jo bo nonofileng jo bo neng bo busiwa ke motho yo o maatla yo o neng a bolela gore o na le bomodimo mo bathong botlhe.
Ke ne ke direla jaaka modiredi yo o ikanyegang wa mmusi yono, ke diragatsa keletso nngwe le nngwe ya bone le taelo ya bone.
Fa morongwa wa ga Allah a tla mo lefatsheng la rona a re bitsa kwa boammaaruring, nna le mmusi wa me re ne ra gana go reetsa.
Ke ne ka laelwa go gotsa molelo o mogolo le go baakanya ditena tsa letsopa gore go agiwe kago e kgolo.
Mmusi wa me o ne a batla go aga kago e e kwa godimo thata mo e neng e tla fitlha kwa magodimong ka boone.
Kwa bofelong, nna le mmusi wa me, masole a rona re ne ra gogolwa mme ra nwela mo botennyeng jwa lewatle.

arabic: أَسْبَـٰبَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَـٰذِبًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍۢ
verse: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin. (40:37)
